overview: An AI-powered interview practice platform for BCA AI/ML students. Practice tech interviews with real-time NLP feedback, session tracking, performance analytics, and downloadable PDF reports — all focused on placement preparation.
features: Internet Identity login with persistent user profiles
Dashboard with session stats, score trends, and category performance charts
Interview sessions with 30-second timer per question and auto-advance
5 question categories: Python Basics, Machine Learning, Data Structures, AI Concepts, Database
AI/NLP answer analysis: keyword matching, grammar check, confidence score, sentiment analysis
Better answer suggestions after each submission
Result analysis page with question-by-question breakdown
PDF report download with full session summary
30+ placement-focused interview questions with difficulty levels
